summary: New in Update 17.0 and, per Beasty and Valdy, overtuned at launch. Town Centers make villagers for free, so 2 or even 3 TCs are hard to punish. Beasty learns the civ with Baugr Fort 1 TC infantry and Sacred Groves; Swaggy and Valdy boom off Konungr Hall into a 2nd TC before 5:00.
openings: Beasty's 1 TC: Longhouse by the TC, 2 Bondi to snipe mining camps (not vs English or Lancaster), 6 on deer for the food Saga, Baugr Fort, then Hirdmen, Berserkers and 3 Völur for Sacred Groves on relics.
Konungr Hall 2 TC (Swaggy, Valdy): 3 on gold, stragglers, 5 on stone, 2nd TC placed around 4:18 and done by 5:00, then nonstop Longhouses with Bee Skeps.
Castle around 8:45 off 2 TC with Valdemar Castle for knights and archers, or Gullinn Temple for faster grove Berserkers on the 1 TC plan.

spikes.label: Early Bondi and Sagas
spikes.detail: Two Bondi from the Longhouse hunt mining camps: killing two eco buildings completes a Saga that makes their techs cheaper and faster. Infantry heal by eating any food.
spikes.answer: Delete your own mining camp before their spears reach it, and keep villagers off isolated gold.

spikes.label: Sacred Groves and free villagers
spikes.detail: Up to 3 groves on relics or sacred sites spawn free Berserkers (around a minute and a half each) and give +1 armor nearby. On 2 TC, villagers never stop coming.
spikes.answer: Kill groves (650 HP) before they pay off, and raid Longhouses: they hold the villager cap.

spikes.label: Valdemar Castle and archer volleys
spikes.detail: Valdy calls Valdemar Castle the strongest landmark in the game: palisades become Danevirke walls sturdier than stone, and Jylland Knights refund gold. Viking archers fire splash volleys Beasty calls overpowered.
spikes.answer: Spread your army against archer volleys; spearmen and crossbows against the knights; siege for the walls.

spikes.label: 220 population
spikes.detail: Population goes to 210, or 220 with Folkekirken, and melee infantry get stronger.
spikes.answer: Win before they max out, or out-range the infantry with handcannons and siege.

scout: Bondi at your gold before 2:00 means the 1 TC Baugr Fort plan
Konungr Hall plus stone villagers means a 2nd TC before 5:00
Völur walking to relics means Sacred Groves
Number of Longhouses: their villager cap and how hard they're booming

pairings.why: Beasty's Feudal infantry: armored front line plus fast self-healing damage, topped up by grove Berserkers.
Valdy and Swaggy's 2 TC defense: spears against cavalry, javelins against archers.
The Valdemar Castle style: cheap knights in front of splash-volley archers.

winConditions.detail: Free villagers from 2 to 3 TCs out-produce anyone who doesn't punish them.
Mass melee infantry with high torch damage that heals on enemy food.
Sacred Groves on relics or sacred sites make free Berserkers.

howToBeat: Punish early: once a 2nd or 3rd TC is up, the free villagers snowball.
Kill Longhouses: every one lowers their villager cap and population.
Delete your own mining camp before Bondi reach it so they don't finish the cheaper-tech Saga.
Burn Sacred Groves; Beasty says groves on sacred sites die easily.
Don't clump against their archers' splash volleys; spearmen and crossbows answer Jylland Knights.
